title: Dominion Post — Greer Building
services: Field Study · HVAC Upgrade · Electrical Upgrade · Construction Administration
overview: A field study of the newspaper's Greer Building found HVAC disintegration, air-quality concerns, and cross-connected air systems — and that the power had to be upgraded before the HVAC work. MEI delivered a phased electrical and HVAC overhaul with the owner in continuous occupancy; the building also serves as an emergency broadcast center for north-central WV.
